title: dupatya oblonga
intro: Dupatya oblonga, commonly known as Bael or Wood Apple, is a deciduous tree native to the Indian subcontinent and Southeast Asia. It has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, such as diarrhea, dysentery, and fever, due to its health benefits, which include its antimicrobial, antiviral, and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Dupatya oblonga include its ability to reduce inflammation, soothe digestive issues, and exhibit antioxidant activity. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, terpenoids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
